review.content_class_rationale: One-page PDF table of the ACMG variant pathogenicity criteria (PVS1 to PP5) with category labels and a footnote naming the classified variant; it is a classification guideline table and contains no patient measurements.

estimated_counts.basis: Machine page count of the downloaded PDF confirmed on the rendered page.

review.notes: Supplementary Table S1 criteria for classifying pathogenic variants according to ACMG guidelines; referenced by the article for the variant classification.
limitations: The footnote says the criteria selected for the variant are shown in green, but the rendered page showed no visible color marking, so the selected criteria could not be read from the file.
Reviewed from the rendered page and extracted text of the single PDF.
